CHEMBL6087407.title: Design and evaluation of 4-(4-methyl-4H-1,2,4-triazol-3-yl)piperidine derivatives
CHEMBL6087407.problem: Identify the structural features that drive activity in this inhibitor series and select compounds for confirmation.
CHEMBL6087407.conclusion: The 4-methyl-1,2,4-triazol-3-yl piperidine chemotype and its substitution pattern are central to activity.

CHEMBL6087417.title: The synthesis and antileukemic activity of 5-substituted thiazolyl urea derivatives
CHEMBL6087417.problem: Identify the structural features that drive antileukemic activity in this thiazolyl-urea series.
CHEMBL6087417.conclusion: The thiazolyl urea core and its substitution pattern drive the observed antileukemic activity.

CHEMBL6078657.title: Thiazolidinedione-based structure modification of ergosterol peroxide
CHEMBL6078657.problem: Identify whether thiazolidinedione modification of the ergosterol-peroxide scaffold preserves or improves activity.
CHEMBL6078657.conclusion: Activity is governed by the thiazolidinedione-modified steroidal scaffold and its substituent pattern.
